objective: Estimate movement, production and interaction effects in the preregistered 2x2 channel design using E0-frozen SESOI values and Holm correction.

data_checksums.generated_inputs: SHA-256 values are written by the committed generator to workspace/matched_input_audit.json before execution

failure_policy: A failed E0 dependency, matching audit or stationarity gate blocks analysis. Valid non-identification is reported as inconclusive rather than repaired by post hoc tuning.
